bio: This is a place that has all the makings of a cherished favourite restaurant! Tucked away in a courtyard, the atmosphere is lively and pleasantly laid back. Closely spaced tables and Turkish background music add to the bustling and vibrant feel. In the open kitchen, the chefs serve up freshly crafted modern Turkish dishes packed with bold flavours and sometimes with a touch of heat. Be sure to try the çiğ köfte (plant-based or meat kofta) and the baklava! Drawing on Middle Eastern culinary tradition, the menu features an array of snacks and larger platters that are idea for sharing. The Gülty Menü Sürpriz is also an excellent choice (by the table only). Tip: Creative cocktails available at the restaurant's own bar....
